svg.title: GitHub contribution activity - mobile calendar
svg.desc: 640 contributions shown on the public GitHub profile from 2025-10-05 through 2026-10-10, across 51 active days. The calendar is split into two chronological strips. All 371 cells use GitHub-reported daily counts and intensity levels; no dates are omitted or repeated. Public counts can include anonymized private contributions if the account has chosen to display them. Snapshot fetched 2026-10-10T23:18:02.740Z.
